## Summary

Describe the user-facing problem and the proposed change.

## Validation

- [ ] pnpm typecheck
- [ ] pnpm test
- [ ] pnpm test:e2e
- [ ] Documentation updated when needed
- [ ] No private knowledge-base content, local paths, credentials, or learning
      state included

## Screenshots

Add privacy-safe screenshots for visible UI changes, or write “Not applicable”.

## Security and data boundary

Explain whether the change affects filesystem access, IPC, navigation, network
behavior, or the read-only knowledge-base guarantee.
